property_summary: For any admin address, initializing the adapter behind a fresh ERC-1967 proxy must succeed, because the initializer modifier must set _initializing=true before the nested onlyInitializing __Access_init runs; the mutant drops that write so initialize always reverts with NotInitializing.
change_summary: Remove `$._initializing = true;` so nested onlyInitializing checks (e.g. in __Access_init) revert with NotInitializing, making initialize fail.
